name: Sunanda Pradhan

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sunanda Pradhan writes in Odia and is based in Bhubaneswar, according to the contributor note supplied to Kabita Live. In “ଗଛ” (“Tree”), a small potted plant opens a question about the space people are willing to leave for other living things.

The speaker imagines branches heavy with flowers and fruit, drawing insects, birds, monkeys and people into a shared world. Against this abundance comes the objection that there is barely room for humans. The ending reverses that assumption: trees might flourish without people, while human life cannot dispense with trees.
